name: Tres Leches
ingredients: 14 oz can sweetened condensed milk (milk mixture)
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13 pan with non-stick spray.
2. In a medium bowl combine flour, baking powder and salt. Separate the eggs into two mixing bowls.
3. Add 3/4 cup sugar to the yolks and beat on high until pale yellow. Add 1/3 cup milk and vanilla. Pour over the flour mixture and stir gently just until combined.
4. Beat the egg whites on high; as they reach stiff peaks gradually add the remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Gently fold into the batter.
5. Pour into the pan, smooth, and bake 25-35 min until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely.
6. Combine evaporated milk, condensed milk and whole milk. Poke holes all over the cooled cake with a fork and slowly pour the milk mixture over, especially near the edges.
7. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.
8. Whip heavy cream, sugar and vanilla to stiff peaks; spread over the cake. Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve with sliced strawberries if desired.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Pound Cake (Bundt)
instructions:
1. Cream together sugar, butter and Crisco/coconut oil. Blend very well.
2. Add eggs one at a time, blending in between.
3. Alternate flour and buttermilk: 1 cup flour, 1/2 cup buttermilk, 1 cup flour, 1/2 cup buttermilk, 1 cup flour — scraping the bowl each time.
4. Add vanilla and baking powder; mix 5-10 min.
5. Transfer to a HEAVILY greased 9.5" bundt pan (PAM baking spray never fails).
6. Start in a COLD oven set to 300°F; bake ~1 1/2 hours until a toothpick comes out dry.
7. Rest 5-10 min, then flip out of the pan.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions:
1. Yeast mixture: combine lukewarm water, yeast and sugar; let sit 10 min.
2. Combine all dough ingredients with the yeast mixture and knead ~10 min until smooth.
3. Place in a floured bowl and proof 2 hours. Proof-box method: heat oven to 200°F, turn it off, and place a cup of boiling water inside with the dough.
4. Roll out the dough and spread with the cinnamon mixture. Roll up, slice, and proof a second time without heat.
5. Bake at 325°F for 30 min.
6. Beat cream cheese, vanilla and powdered sugar for the icing; spread on warm rolls.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates. Your notes: try milk instead of water; try vital wheat gluten; bread flour is definitely superior. (Water temp fixed from '110-110f' to 110°F.)

name: Focaccia
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil (+ more for pan and drizzling)
instructions:
1. Whisk water, yeast and honey; let bloom. Whisk in olive oil and sea salt.
2. Add flour; combine, cover, rest 10 min.
3. With wet hands, stretch and pull. Cover, rest 10 min. Stretch and pull again.
4. Place ball smooth side up, drizzle with olive oil, and let rest overnight (or 2 nights) in the fridge.
5. Prep a pan with parchment and oil. Slide dough on, fold into a burrito, flip over, cover and proof 2 hours.
6. Oil and spread the dough to the corners, drizzle with olive oil, dimple, and sprinkle flaky salt.
7. Bake on the lowest rack at 430°F for 18-22 min.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Mediterranean Chicken & Rice

4. Add diced carrots; sauté 2 more min.
5. Add rinsed rice and mix well.

7. Add chicken back to the pan and bring to a boil. Cover, lower heat, and cook ~20 min.

name: Apple Fritter Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt (plain or vanilla), room temp
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and line a loaf pan with parchment.
2. Brown the butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring (~5-8 min). Pour into a large bowl and chill to cool.
3. Swirl: mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Apples: toss chopped apples with sugar and cinnamon.
4. Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
5. Beat the cooled brown butter with the sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, then vanilla.
6. Add half the flour mix, then half the yogurt; repeat.
7. Layer: half the batter, half the apples, half the swirl. Repeat, pressing apples in a bit.
8. Bake 50-65 min until a toothpick has a few moist crumbs. Cool 15 min, then move to a rack.
9. Whisk glaze ingredients and drizzle over the loaf.

name: Veggie Burgers + Avocado Crema

4. Sauté mushrooms in 2 tbsp olive oil with salt and pepper until golden and the liquid is gone, 8-10 min. Add garlic, soy sauce and paprika; cook 1 min. Cool.
5. In a large bowl combine cooled veggies, breadcrumbs, eggs and black beans (+ mushrooms). Mix well, then fold in quinoa.
6. Form 6 patties, 1/2 inch thick. Refrigerate up to 24 hours.
7. Cook in a non-stick or cast iron skillet on med-high 2 min per side, then lower to medium-low and cook 7-9 min total.
8. Crema: blend avocado with the remaining crema ingredients until smooth.

name: Arroz con Pollo
ingredients: 1 whole head garlic (+2 cloves for blend)
1 packet Sazón Goya con culantro y achiote
salt (~1/2 cup for boiling, less is fine)
instructions:
1. Soak rice in warm water ~10 min, then wash until the water runs clear. Strain as dry as possible for better frying.
2. Bring a big pot of water to a boil for the chicken.
3. Clean the chicken: burn off yellow ends/feathers on drumsticks over the stove flame and pull off; remove skin from thighs. Wash with cold water.
4. Add chicken to the boiling water with a head of garlic (end cut off) and half an onion.
5. When it boils again, skim off foam/impurities. Add salt and boil ~40 min.
6. Blend 4 tomatoes, 2 garlic cloves, a few pieces of onion (~1/8), the Sazón packet and ~1/3 cup water until smooth.
7. Fry the rice on medium-high (glossy with oil), stirring constantly, until golden (~21 min).
8. Pour in the tomato blend and stir until absorbed (~4 min). For every cup of rice add 2 cups chicken broth.
9. Add chicken if not fully cooked, bring to a boil, cover and simmer until done.

instructions:

instructions:

6. Roll each ball into a 1/4-inch oval; cook in an oiled pan over medium 1-2 min per side until golden.
7. Brush with garlic butter and serve immediately.

name: Sourdough Apple Cinnamon Scones
ingredients: 30g (2 tbsp) heavy cream, cold (+ more for brushing)
instructions:
1. Whisk flour, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
2. Grate in the cold butter and work into pea-sized crumbs.
3. Stir in the chopped apples (Honeycrisp, Gala or Pink Lady).
4. Whisk discard, egg, cream and vanilla (all cold); pour into the dry mix and stir until just combined (crumbly).
5. Knead ~30 seconds, form an 8-inch disc and cut 8 wedges.
6. Space on a parchment-lined tray and chill at least 30 min while the oven preheats to 400°F.
7. Brush with cream, sprinkle with coarse sugar and cinnamon; bake 21-23 min until golden.

name: Lava Cake for Two
ingredients: 3 oz 60% bittersweet chocolate (a little less than 1/2 cup chips)
powdered sugar, raspberries, vanilla ice cream (for serving)
instructions:
1. Generously butter and lightly flour two 6-8 oz ramekins.
2. Beat egg, yolk, sugar and salt until thick and pale.
3. Melt butter with chocolate (double boiler or microwave) and whisk smooth.
4. Fold the chocolate and flour into the eggs; divide between ramekins.
5. Bake at 450°F for 10-12 min until edges are set but the center is soft.
6. Cool 1 minute, then invert. Serve with powdered sugar, raspberries and ice cream.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Chocolate Lava Cakes (Serves 3)
ingredients: fresh raspberries and powdered sugar, to garnish
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 430°F.
2. Melt chopped chocolate and butter in a double boiler; set aside.
3. Whisk eggs, yolks, sugar and salt vigorously until pale. Fold in the chocolate, then sift in the flour and fold again.
4. Butter and sugar three 6 oz ramekins; divide the batter.
5. Bake 11-13 min. Cool 5 min, invert and garnish with raspberries and powdered sugar.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Strawberry Short Cupcakes
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray 18 muffin cups.
2. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Combine milk and vanilla. Beat 1 1/2 cups sugar with butter ~3 min; add eggs one at a time. Alternate flour and milk mixtures. Fill cups 3/4 full.
3. Bake 18-20 min. Cool 10 min in pans, then on racks.
4. Whip cream to soft peaks; add 3 tbsp sugar and beat to stiff peaks.
5. Halve each cupcake; fill with ~2 tbsp cream and strawberries, replace the top, and finish with more cream and berries.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Almond Raspberry Cream Cupcakes
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 18 muffin cups.
2. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Beat sugar, butter and extracts 4 min until fluffy. Add eggs and yolks one at a time. Alternate flour and milk. Fill cups 3/4 full.
3. Bake 20-22 min. Cool 15 min in pans, then on racks.
4. Raspberry cream: beat cream and powdered sugar 5 min until almost stiff; fold in lightly mashed raspberries.
5. Cut tops off the cupcakes, spread with raspberry cream, replace tops and dust with powdered sugar.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates. PREFILLED: '2 eggs' — the steps say 'eggs and egg yolks' but only the yolks were legible in the photo.

name: Tropical Luau Cupcakes
ingredients: 2 cans (8 oz each) crushed pineapple in juice
1 package (~18 oz) yellow cake mix (without pudding)
1 package (4-serving) banana cream instant pudding mix
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 30 muffin cups. Drain pineapple, reserving the juice.
2. Beat cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, reserved juice, oil and nutmeg on low 1 min, then medium 1-2 min. Fold in pineapple. Fill cups 2/3 full.
3. Bake 20 min. Cool 5 min in pans, then on racks.
4. Frost and sprinkle with toasted coconut (toast at 350°F for 5-7 min).
5. Palm trees: slice kiwi 1/8-inch thick, cut fronds toward the center, push a pretzel stick into each slice, and stand in the cupcakes.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates. PREFILLED: egg count (3) — not legible in the photo.

name: Blueberry Crisp Cupcakes
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 30 muffin cups.
2. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Beat sugar and butter 1 min; add milk and vanilla. Gradually add flour; beat 2 min. Add egg whites; beat 1 min.
3. Fill cups half full, sprinkle with blueberries and bake 10 min.
4. Streusel: mix flour, oats, brown sugar and cinnamon; cut in butter; stir in nuts.
5. Sprinkle streusel over the partially baked cupcakes and bake 18-20 min more. Cool.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates.

name: Piña Colada Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup flaked coconut (+ more for garnish)
1 can (8 oz) crushed pineapple in juice, undrained
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line 18 muffin cups.
2. Combine flour, sugar, coconut, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
3. Beat eggs; blend in sour cream, pineapple with juice, butter and coconut extract. Stir into the flour mixture just until moistened. Fill cups 3/4 full.
4. Bake 10 min, sprinkle with coconut, and bake 5-10 min more. Cool 2 min.
notes: Macros are rough per-serving estimates. Sugar is 3/4 cup in one photo and 1/4 cup in another (OCR) — 3/4 cup used.

name: Oreo Cinnamon Rolls
instructions:
1. Mix the milk, egg, vanilla and melted butter.
2. Mix dry ingredients in a separate bowl, make a well and add the wet ingredients.
3. Mix into a uniform (very sticky) dough — that's what makes them gooey.
4. Cover and proof 1 hour.
5. Roll out, brush with melted butter, sprinkle with brown sugar, crushed Oreos and cinnamon. Roll up and cut 9 rolls.
6. Proof 30 min in a lined pan, then bake at 350°F for 25-30 min.
7. Beat the frosting ingredients and spread on the warm rolls.

3. Beat butter and both sugars until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
4. Mix in the dry ingredients alternately with the apple cider.

name: Apple Bread Pudding
ingredients: 8 thick slices brioche, cubed and dried overnight
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch round (or 8-9 inch square) pan and line with parchment.
2. Cook apples in butter until soft; stir in flour, apple pie spice, brown sugar and water and simmer until thick and caramel-like.
3. Custard: warm milk, cream, butter, sugar and salt until the butter melts; cool slightly, then whisk in vanilla, cinnamon, spice and eggs.
4. Spread the apple caramel in the pan, top with bread cubes, and pour the custard over; soak 15 min.
5. Bake 40-50 min until set and golden.

name: Cinnamon Roll Pound Cake

2. Cream butter and sugar 5-7 min until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time.
3. Whisk flour, salt and baking soda; add alternately with the sour cream. Mix in oil and vanilla.
4. Stir the swirl ingredients together.

instructions:
